about: The playthrough's Route 32, from Violet City's Pokemon Center: out of Violet's south exit, where the man on the route's first corridor walks up (a coord event the way south steps on, VAR_UNK_408D) and, the egg in the party, gives the Miracle Seed (FLAG_UNK_074); down the route, Youngster Albert and the wild Pokemon on the way -- where the leg was written the Geodude led and the Misdreavus did most of the fighting, 13 to 15, learning Confuse Ray (30,450 frames; on round 14's merged tree 13 to 14, Confuse Ray, 29,080 frames as the joined chain plays it) -- to the route's Pokemon Center, where the fishing guru gives the Old Rod (FLAG_GOT_OLD_ROD, a yes taken by A); the nurse, and the game's save. The party is the team leg 05 brought, the one the bot caught and trained, no edit -- the Geodude, the Cyndaquil, the Misdreavus, the Hoothoot at 10, the Mareep, all the others at 13, and the egg; Falkner's badge has lifted the cap to 19. Split from Union Cave to keep each leg near three or four minutes. The field's RNG is pinned and the battle's seed fixed.
